sentences: A concurrent FIFO queue should return items in insertion order while allowing many processes to enqueue and dequeue simultaneously.
Wait-freedom requires each operation to finish after a bounded number of its own steps regardless of interference.
The question asks for an exact linearizable queue with O(log n) worst-case step complexity and no restriction on which of the n processes may perform either operation.
The source reaches logarithmic bounds by relaxing semantics or limiting dequeuers, leaving the unrestricted exact version separate.
An implementation would reconcile strong progress and ordering guarantees with low latency under arbitrary concurrent access.
